page_title: SPA 3-0 AUS | Spain v Austria 02/07/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' The referee blows for the end of today's match.
90+4' Ferran Torres (Spain) smashes the ball from the edge of the box and misses well wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Austria.
90+3' Luis de la Fuente has decided to substitute Aymeric Laporte and he is replaced by Marc Pubill (Spain).
90+3' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Fabian Ruiz (Spain) comes onto the pitch so that Pedri can be given a rest.
90+2' Marcel Sabitzer (Austria) delivers a promising cross into the box, but it's cleared.
90' The fourth official shows 6 min. of added time.

89' 3 - 0 What a goal! Marc Cucurella plays it to Mikel Oyarzabal (Spain), who finds himself unmarked inside the box and slots a first-time shot past Alexander Schlager into the bottom right corner. 3:0.
87' Sasa Kalajdzic (Austria) found some space to play in a lofted pass, but he looks disappointed as none of his teammates managed to connect with it.
87' Flag up against Marko Arnautovic (Austria). He had space to move into behind the defence, but he went too soon.
85' Here is a change. Stefan Posch is going off and Ralf Rangnick gives the last tactical orders to Alexander Prass (Austria).
85' Substitution. Lamine Yamal is replaced by Gavi (Spain).

85' Lamine Yamal (Spain) is the first to arrive to a rebound inside the penalty area and unleashes a quick strike towards the bottom left corner that beats the keeper. One of the defenders, however, makes a goal-line clearance.
83' The foul by Stefan Posch (Austria) is worthy of a card and a yellow is duly shown by Glenn Nyberg.

82' Marcel Sabitzer plays a delightful lofted ball into the middle of the box and it deserved better, but Stefan Posch (Austria) could only send a weak header well wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Spain.
81' Glenn Nyberg blows his whistle as Mikel Merino (Spain) used excessive force in the tackle during an attack.

79' Carney Chukwuemeka (Austria) receives a well-played pass inside the penalty area and shoots. His effort sails well wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Spain will have a goal kick.
79' Marcel Sabitzer (Austria) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders.

78' The whipped in corner perfectly picks out Ferran Torres (Spain) near the penalty spot, but the ball comes off the top of his head and goes a mile over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Austria.
78' Lamine Yamal (Spain) looks like he will be the one to take the corner kick.
77' Mikel Merino (Spain) attempts to send over a cross in order to find one of his teammates, but an opposition defender averts the danger by intercepting the effort.
76' Marko Arnautovic (Austria) looks to break free, but his touch lets him down and he loses the ball. The ball goes out of play and Spain will have a goal kick.
75' Marc Cucurella (Spain) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Glenn Nyberg no option but to blow his whistle.
74' Marko Arnautovic (Austria) deprives his opponent of the ball, but the referee blows his whistle for a foul. He's not happy with the decision!
73' The attendance is 70492.
71' Luis de la Fuente prepares a substitution. Dani Olmo is replaced by Mikel Merino (Spain).
71' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Alex Baena departs the field of play to be replaced by Ferran Torres (Spain).
68' A cooling break is underway.
66' 2 - 0 Goal! Alex Baena picks out Pedro Porro (Spain) with a perfect cross, and he has no problem to nod the ball into an empty net. It's 2:0.
65' The ball is cleared after Lamine Yamal (Spain) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
65' Marko Arnautovic (Austria) is moving okay again after that injury scare.
63' Marko Arnautovic (Austria) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
63' Glenn Nyberg blows his whistle and it's Marko Arnautovic (Austria) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee.
62' The linesman raises his flag for offside before Lamine Yamal (Spain) heads on.
62' Dani Olmo (Spain) takes a first-time shot from the edge of the box, but his effort is well blocked by the defender.

61' Sasa Kalajdzic (Austria) wins himself enough space to connect with a cross inside the box, but his fine header goes narrowly over the crossbar! The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Spain.
60' Ralf Rangnick has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Sasa Kalajdzic (Austria) replacing Romano Schmid.
60' It's time for a substitution. That's the last involvement from Michael Gregoritsch as he is replaced by Marko Arnautovic (Austria).
60' Marcel Sabitzer (Austria) is adjudged offside.
59' Lamine Yamal (Spain) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being blocked by one of the defenders.
58' Alex Baena (Spain) hammers the ball towards goal from long-range, but one of the defenders reacts brilliantly to block the shot.
57' Pedro Porro (Spain) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out.
55' Stefan Posch (Austria) carelessly slides into the feet of his opponent and he'll be lucky to avoid punishment. Glenn Nyberg blows for the foul but keeps his cards in his pocket on this occasion.
55' Alex Baena (Spain) swings in a dangerous cross from the resulting corner kick, but none of his teammates manage to outjump the defence.

54' Rodri (Spain) finds himself with a great opportunity! He unleashes a shot from the edge of the box, which whizzes just wide of the left post! The ball goes out of play and Austria will have a goal kick.
53' Marc Cucurella (Spain) tries to send a pass but it's blocked.

52' The corner is aimed towards the penalty spot where it's met by Mikel Oyarzabal (Spain), but his timing is poor and it flies high over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Austria will have a goal kick.
51' The referee awards a corner and Alex Baena (Spain) goes over to take it.
51' Dani Olmo (Spain) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away. Now Spain have a corner.

49' That didn't go as planned! Mikel Oyarzabal (Spain) tried his luck from the edge of the box, but his effort low towards the middle of the goal was too weak to get past Alexander Schlager, who easily kept it out.
49' Lamine Yamal (Spain) manages to beat his opponent to the ball, but he commits a foul in the process.
47' Paul Wanner (Austria) was too forceful with his tackle and Glenn Nyberg interrupted the game to signal a free kick.
46' Half-time substitution. Xaver Schlager (Austria) will not participate anymore and Florian Grillitsch is coming on.
46' Ralf Rangnick has made a change at the break. Carney Chukwuemeka has come on in place of Nicolas Seiwald (Austria).
46' The half-time break is over and the second half is about to start.
45+5' The match has reached half-time.
45+3' Lamine Yamal (Spain) has a great chance inside the six-yard box, shoots to the middle of the goal, but Alexander Schlager pulls off an exquisite save to deny him.
45+2' Alex Baena (Spain) produces a decent strike goalwards from the resulting set piece. His effort crashes against the crossbar and the ball stays out of the net. The goalkeeper was quite lucky!
45+1' Stefan Posch (Austria) escapes without any punishment from the referee after using excessive force to foul his opponent. Spain have a free kick from a promising distance.
45' 4 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
45' Michael Gregoritsch (Austria) finds himself beyond the last defender, but the game is stopped by the referee after the linesman signals for offside.
44' Marcel Sabitzer (Austria) brings an opponent down and Glenn Nyberg interrupts the game.
43' Xaver Schlager (Austria) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
42' Alexander Schlager leaps to intercept the corner kick from Alex Baena (Spain).
41' Mikel Oyarzabal (Spain) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball away to eliminate the danger. Spain force their opponents to concede a corner.
40' Mikel Oyarzabal (Spain) receives a good pass just outside the box, unleashes a strike from a promising position, but the shot is blocked by the defender.

39' Lamine Yamal (Spain) brilliantly evades multiple challenges and bends in a shot from the edge of the box towards the middle of the goal. It's a weak effort, however, and is easily saved by Alexander Schlager.
38' Marcel Sabitzer (Austria) did his best to latch on to a crossfield pass, but it was too long and it goes out of play. The ball goes out of play and Spain will have a goal kick.

36' 1 - 0 Goal! Mikel Oyarzabal (Spain) shows good awareness inside the box as he latches on to a brilliant pass and fires a first-time shot into the bottom right corner. Marc Cucurella assisted in the goal. 1:0.
36' Mikel Oyarzabal (Spain) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked.
35' David Alaba (Austria) moves forward and unleashes a thunderous shot from distance that flies well over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Spain.
34' The game is interrupted as Lamine Yamal (Spain) is flagged offside.
33' Alexander Schlager comes off his line to intercept the corner from Lamine Yamal (Spain).

33' A sweet pass finds Mikel Oyarzabal (Spain) on the edge of the box, and he drills the ball towards the bottom right corner. Alexander Schlager is almost caught out but pulls off a brilliant save at the last second. Spain have a corner.
32' Lamine Yamal (Spain) amazingly found his way through the defence, but lacked a precise finish as his effort from close range went slightly wide of the left post.
30' Goal disallowed! Marc Cucurella (Spain) scores but Glenn Nyberg blows his whistle for a foul.
29' The ball is out of play and Spain manage to earn a corner.
29' Dani Olmo (Spain) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away. The ball is out of play and Spain manage to earn a corner.
27' Pedro Porro (Spain) fizzes over a cross which doesn't cause any problems.
24' The referee blows his whistle and players are going to refresh themselves.
22' Mikel Oyarzabal (Spain) does his best to latch onto a cross into the box, but he can't get to the ball.
19' Pedro Porro (Spain) sends a cross into the box, but Alexander Schlager comes off his line to gather the ball.

18' Marcel Sabitzer (Austria) clips a neat ball into the box in the direction of Michael Gregoritsch, but he can't get on the end of the pass. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Spain.
16' Paul Wanner (Austria) shows too much aggression while trying to break free from his opponent and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
15' Glenn Nyberg couldn't ignore the rough tackle by David Alaba (Austria) and blew his whistle.
12' Alex Baena (Spain) steps up to take the corner. He launches the ball into the penalty area, but it only finds the head of an opposing player who clears the danger.
12' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Alex Baena (Spain). The ball is out of play. Spain will have a chance to score from a corner.
11' Lamine Yamal (Spain) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
11' Kevin Danso (Austria) brings his opponent down. Glenn Nyberg has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle for a foul. Spain win a free kick.

9' Aymeric Laporte (Spain) times his run and jump perfectly to get on the end of the resulting corner, but the ball comes off the top of his head and goes miles over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Austria will have a goal kick.
8' Spain win a corner.
8' The ball is cleared after Marc Cucurella (Spain) attempted to dribble past an opposing player. Spain win a corner.
7' Dani Olmo (Spain) shoots from outside the box, but his effort is blocked.
6' Alex Baena (Spain) takes a short corner kick.
5' Lamine Yamal (Spain) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared. The ball goes out of play and Spain have been awarded a corner kick.
4' Romano Schmid (Austria) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack.

2' Lamine Yamal (Spain) beats a couple of players and hammers in a low shot from mid-range towards the middle of the goal. The keeper is caught unaware but still pulls off a great save to deny the effort.
1' Marcel Sabitzer (Austria) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence quickly intercepts the ball.
